I help my family farm this millet plot, and we will apply a small amount of NPK fertilizer because the soil here in the North West is poor and millet needs nutrients to yield well. We also spread manure from our livestock, and we plant the local millet seeds we saved from last season since improved seeds are hard to find and cost too much for our small plot. My parents, brothers, and I will do all the work ourselves across the season, so we do not need to hire outside labor, and we depend entirely on the rains because there is no irrigation water nearby.
